process.title: From first call to launch, in four clear steps

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.body: A free 30-minute call to understand your goals, users and constraints. You leave with honest advice, even if we're not the right fit.

steps.title: Scope and proposal
steps.body: We turn the conversation into a written scope with milestones, a timeline and a fixed quote or package.

steps.title: Design and build
steps.body: Short cycles with working demos. You see progress every week and can change direction early, when it's cheap.

steps.title: Launch and support
steps.body: We launch, monitor and hand over documentation. Ongoing support and improvements are available when you need them.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope. After a free discovery call we send a written proposal with a fixed quote or a package price, so you know the cost before any work starts. Our packages page shows common bundles.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Your proposal includes a timeline with milestones. A marketing website is usually a matter of weeks; web and mobile apps take longer depending on features. We share working demos throughout, so you're never waiting until the end to see progress.

faq.q: Do you build in Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. We build bilingual Arabic and English products with proper right-to-left layouts, Arabic typography and local integrations.

faq.q: Who owns the code and designs?
faq.a: Ownership of custom deliverables is set out in your contract. We document the work and hand it over so your team, or any future team, can maintain it.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing team or system?
faq.a: Yes. We often extend existing products, integrate with tools you already use, or work alongside your in-house developers.

faq.q: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We monitor launches, fix issues, and offer ongoing improvement and maintenance plans.

p: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the websites, applications and related services offered by Xaeon Software Solutions ("Xaeon", "we", "us" or "our"). By using our services, you agree to these Terms.
Descriptions of our services on this site are for general information. Specific deliverables, timelines and fees are defined only in a written agreement or statement of work between you and Xaeon.

You agree not to misuse our services, including by attempting to access systems or data without authorisation, introduce malware or disrupt infrastructure, or use our brand or materials in a way that is misleading or unlawful.
Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Xaeon retains rights to pre-existing materials, tools and know-how. Ownership of custom deliverables will be as set out in your contract with us.

Our site and content are provided "as is" to the extent permitted by law. We do not warrant uninterrupted or error-free operation. Liability is limited to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law and, where permitted, to fees paid to us for the specific engagement giving rise to the claim.
We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
Xaeon Software Solutions ("Xaeon", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy describes how we handle information when you visit our website or engage our services.

Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect contact details you submit (name, email, phone, company), messages and files you send when requesting a quote or support, and technical data such as IP address, browser type and approximate location from standard server logs.
We use this information to respond to enquiries and deliver contracted services, to operate, secure and improve our website, and to comply with legal obligations.
We use cookies and similar technologies that are needed for the site to work, such as keeping you signed in to your client dashboard.

With your consent, we also use Google Analytics to understand how visitors find and use the site, and the Meta Pixel to measure our advertising. Until you accept, Google Analytics runs without cookies and the Meta Pixel does not load. You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link in the footer.

When you send us an enquiry or book a call, we record how you arrived at our site (for example the campaign link, referring website and the first page you visited) with your request, so we know which of our channels are working. You can also control cookies through your browser settings.

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with trusted processors (for example hosting and email providers) who assist our operations under appropriate agreements, or when required by law.
We retain information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law. We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect data.
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or object to certain processing of your personal data. Contact us to make a request.

faq.q: Does Velora work in Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. Velora is fully bilingual in English and Arabic, for staff and for patients.

faq.q: Can patients book online?
faq.a: Yes. Patients book from your website or a shared link, and receive WhatsApp confirmations and reminders.

faq.q: Do I build the website myself?
faq.a: No. You choose and customise in the builder; our team builds, checks and launches it with your content.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Most Launch and Business sites go live within 1–3 weeks of receiving your content.

faq.q: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a: Yes. Your domain stays in your name; we guide you through connecting it.

faq.q: What does the monthly plan cover?
faq.a: Hosting, SSL, security updates, backups, monitoring and support, plus the features in your plan.

faq.q: Can I change my template later?
faq.a: Yes. Your content and brand move with you; a redesign may have a setup fee.

faq.q: How do I pay?
faq.a: Pay the deposit online by card or wallet where available, or by invoice. The rest is due before launch.
